description: QA routes over Waze's real prompt set. A step is one spoken instruction; phrases inside a step chain with a short breath gap, steps are separated by a longer pause. Waze itself chains a distance callout onto a maneuver, and joins two maneuvers with AndThen, so the routes here do the same.

routes.label: Basic city route, imperial
routes.notes: The everyday case. Listen for distance and maneuver clips that do not sit well together.

routes.label: Basic city route, metric
routes.notes: Same drive with the metric file set. Run both: a pack missing one set falls back to the default Waze voice mid-drive, which is worse than it sounds.

routes.label: Two maneuvers joined by AndThen
routes.notes: AndThen is the hardest clip to get right. It has to flow out of one instruction and into another without a seam. If anything in the pack sounds spliced, it shows up here.

routes.label: Roundabout exits
routes.notes: Roundabout chains onto an ordinal. Check that the ordinals share the pace of the maneuver clips.

routes.label: Highway merge and exit
routes.notes: Longer gaps, as at highway speed. Pair with --bed road-noise.wav to check intelligibility over engine and tyre noise.

routes.label: Alert prompts
routes.notes: Optional prompts. These are the first to lose bitrate when a pack is over budget, so listen for artefacts here before shipping.
